summary: Fresh-block replication of the n-tuple leaf at larger scale: added the 2x4 and 4x2 window families with 64-bit pattern indices, a plateau stop rule and lazily zeroed accumulators to the ntuple-scale crate; wrote the successor pipeline, the preregistered experiment and its three fresh leases; ran the gates, the smoke run, the main run and the one-shot screen; wrote the result record, the approach page section, the web figures and the log entry.
validationPerformed: cargo test --release (11 unit tests, including the 2x4 and 4x2 window cell test)
gate binary: 19 CHECK gates on the probe block with the wide layout, all PASS (gates.log); the first invocation's panic on terminal states was fixed before any leased seed was read
throughput smoke run on the probe block (4e7 moves, tables discarded)
make research-validate (no errors on this experiment's records; pre-existing errors concern other contributors' missing runs/ artifacts)
node web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs, node scripts/check-approach-frontmatter.mjs, node web/scripts/check-figures.mjs, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, npm run build under web/
analyze.py evaluated the preregistered candidate gate, the replication criteria and the scale verdict from the screen artifact; compare.py reports written for eight contrasts
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.

The owner asked for a fresh-block replication with a longer and wider training run that stops at a plateau; the model chose the added window families, the plateau rule and the screen design, and ran it on the same workstation as the first experiment, so this is a fresh-block replication by the same runner, not an independent one.
